meaning:
1) to loathe, be grieved, feel a loathing
1a) (Qal) to feel a loathing
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to feel loathing against self
1b2) to detest
1c) (Hithpolel) to loathe oneself
Also means: na.qat (נָקַט "to tire" H5354)

elsewhere.note: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed…
